image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two standing coworkers talk beside an office desk. A clearly visible large round wall clock with simple hands and NO numerals hangs above the desk, away from both heads.

coverage_review.scope: W008 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：完整圆形时钟，包括外圈和指针，不凭指针推断预约时间。 前三词由对白提供语境证据，静态画面不能单独证明，不设局部框。 真实裁剪发现切边后按1254尺寸修正并增加6/1000边缘余量。
